testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/checkout/z10-28102-order-receipt-discount.spec.ts > Webstore - Checkout (multistore13 regression) > order receipt shows the correct combined discount (brand 10% + $10 coupon)

scenario.summary: Regression for z10-28102 on Multistore13: a registered user adds a product discounted by an automatic 10% brand promotion, checks the brand discount on the cart, selects Free Shipping, applies a $10 Amount Off Order coupon, places a COD order and checks the combined discount and order total on the receipt and in the order history detail.
steps: Sign in with webstoreUserName/webstorePassword on the Multistore13 webstore, empty the cart and remove all coupons
Add sku at quantity 1; cart discount = subtotal x brandPercentOff / 100 and order total = subtotal - discount
Check out, click Ship Complete and select #FreeShipping-5
Apply couponCode: success text; order total drops by couponAmount
Pay with COD and place the order; receipt discount = brand discount + couponAmount and order total = subtotal + shipping + handling + tax - discount
Open the order from Order History and repeat the discount and order-total checks
stateChanges: One COD order is placed by the declared user with the coupon applied (one coupon redemption consumed)
Cart emptied and coupons removed at the start
assertions: Cart brand discount close to subtotal x brandPercentOff / 100 (precision 2)
Cart order total close to subtotal - brand discount
Coupon success text visible; order total after coupon close to before - couponAmount
Receipt and order-history discount close to brand discount + couponAmount; order total close to the summed lines
Order number captured; order details heading visible
evidence: Title matches the flow; Testim z10_28102 bug-repro (webstore half; the admin OMS cross-check is skipped)
Credentials (masked) name the existing registered user: USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED with preferred.required true (credential source).
Store MaxwellsHardwareMultistore13: the spec pins baseURL webstore-multistore13-z10-at; ZnodePortal StoreCode MaxwellsHardwareMultistore13 (PortalId 27) checked read-only with tda rows.

couponCode 'amountOff' (live, read-only: promotion amountOff, Amount Off Order, Discount 10, OrderMinimum 0, no profile, PortalId 27 = Multistore13, AvailableQuantity 9999): COUPON_AMOUNT_OFF_ORDER discountAmount 10 (couponAmount 10.00 is its discountAmount), allProfiles true, single coupon so allowedWithOtherCoupons false, redemptionsNeeded 1 (the order consumes one).

Missing key: an automatic (no coupon) Percent Off Brand promotion on MaxwellsHardwareMultistore13 for the declared user's profile (or all profiles), active now, discount 10 percent (brandPercentOff), with no order minimum the one-unit cart misses, and a product of that brand in stock (the product need must be linked to it). No vocabulary key covers brand promotions; the need is left out. brandPercentOff is recorded as expected-output only because a data source needs a declared alias; it is really that promotion's discount.
sku z-2100025: PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK quantityUsed 1 (preferred, not required); a fallback product would not carry the brand promotion until the brand key exists.

Missing key: the Free Shipping method (code FreeShipping, clicked by the fixed selector #FreeShipping-5 in the spec) associated with the store and the user's profile. No vocabulary key covers free shipping; the need is left out.

DOUBT: proceedFromCart goes straight to shipping, so the account must already have a default shipping/billing address; USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED does not constrain that (same gap as the other retail checkout entries).

Data in code: the test title and a step title name the coupon and amounts ('brand 10% + $10 coupon', 'apply the $10 amountOff coupon'); the test account name appears in a step title. Text only, but it would go stale with resolved data.
